labels.name: Common iliac artery
labels.function: Arises at the L4 bifurcation; splits into pelvic and limb branches

labels.name: Internal iliac artery
labels.function: Supplies the pelvis, gluteal region and medial thigh

labels.name: External iliac artery
labels.function: Takes a new name after passing beneath the inguinal ligament

labels.name: Femoral artery
labels.function: Groin pulse and catheter site; pressed against the hip's ball

labels.name: Deep femoral artery
labels.function: Largest thigh branch; its perforators feed the posterior thigh

labels.name: Lateral circumflex femoral artery
labels.function: Minor supply to the head of the thigh bone; joins hip anastomoses

labels.name: Medial circumflex femoral artery
labels.function: Principal supply to the head and neck of the thigh bone

labels.name: Popliteal artery
labels.function: Fixed deep behind the knee; at risk in knee dislocation

labels.name: Anterior tibial artery
labels.function: Pierces the interosseous membrane to supply the dorsiflexors

labels.name: Fibular artery
labels.function: Supplies the lateral compartment of the leg

labels.name: Posterior tibial artery
labels.function: Pulse behind the medial malleolus; supplies the plantarflexors

labels.name: Dorsalis pedis artery
labels.function: Pulse on top of the foot; weak in peripheral arterial disease

labels.name: Inferior vena cava
labels.function: Final channel returning lower-limb blood to the heart

labels.name: Common iliac vein
labels.function: Last paired deep vein before the caval trunk

labels.name: External iliac vein
labels.function: Continues the thigh's deep vein above the inguinal ligament

labels.name: Femoral vein
labels.function: Receives the main superficial vein just below the ligament

labels.name: Great saphenous vein
labels.function: Starts at the medial foot; varicose when its valves fail

labels.name: Popliteal vein
labels.function: Deep vein behind the knee; a clot here can embolize to the lungs

labels.name: Anterior tibial veins
labels.function: Paired deep veins of the dorsiflexor compartment

labels.name: Posterior tibial veins
labels.function: Paired calf veins squeezed by the skeletal muscle pump

labels.name: Popliteal nodes
labels.function: Palpable nodes behind the knee checked in the leg exam

labels.name: Superficial inguinal nodes
labels.function: Palpable groin nodes checked for infection or malignancy

labels.name: Lumbar lymphatic trunks
labels.function: First trunk channels receiving lymph from both lower limbs

labels.name: Cisterna chyli
labels.function: Abdominal sac where the lower-limb trunks converge

labels.name: Thoracic duct
labels.function: Ascends through the chest carrying lymph from both legs

labels.name: Left subclavian vein
labels.function: Where lymph from both legs re-enters the bloodstream

labels.name: Left supraclavicular (Virchow) node
labels.function: Enlarges with abdominal cancer; lies near the duct's end
